mobility.label: Mobility and urban form
mobility.question: Which cities have a similar shape and similar travel conditions?

subtypes.name: Small, dense, low-income centres
subtypes.description: Small but dense cities with little sealed surface, low income and moderate public transport accessibility.

subtypes.name: Wealthy, spacious, well-served cities
subtypes.description: Larger, high-income cities with low density, extensive sealed surface and high public transport accessibility.

subtypes.name: Large, dense, densifying cities
subtypes.description: Large, dense cities that are still densifying, with unevenly distributed sealing and lower-middle income.

subtypes.name: Small, spread-out, car-oriented towns
subtypes.description: Small, low-density cities with extensive sealed surface and low public transport accessibility.

energy.label: Heat and energy demand
energy.question: Which cities have a similar heating and energy task?

subtypes.name: Cold, wealthy, high-emission, stable cities
subtypes.description: High heating demand, high income and per-capita emissions, low density and little population growth.

subtypes.name: Mixed-climate, wealthy, growing cities
subtypes.description: Both heating and cooling demand, high income and emissions, and a growing population.

subtypes.name: Hot, dense, fast-growing, low-emission cities
subtypes.description: High cooling demand, dense, low income and emissions, and fast population growth.

subtypes.name: Hot, dense, slow-growing cities
subtypes.description: High cooling demand, dense, lower income and emissions, and little population growth.
